$comment: Chrome for Testing's builds for the app's Chromium (ADR 0144), by platform, with the SHA-256 of each zip; e2e/support/chrome-for-testing.ts downloads and checks them. chromedriver: the app e2e attaches to the CEF desk with it. chrome-headless-shell: the runtime e2e and perf run on it (packages/runtime/e2e/chromium.ts), the same build as the CEF desk's engine rather than Playwright's own, an earlier build of the branch whose renderer is killed when a just-created field takes the focus. chromium follows the cef crate (Cargo.toml) and its cef_version.h; Chrome for Testing has no Linux build of 156.0.8078.88, so linux64 takes the branch's latest one there (chromedriver checks the major version only). A CEF bump updates this file in the same change.
